entities.name: José Siro González Bacallao
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Siro González Bacallao was a Cuban Roman Catholic priest and prelate. He served as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Pinar del Río, based in the city of Pinar del Río, from 1982 until 2006. He remained bishop emeritus until his death in 2021.
